title: Ph.D. in Artificial Intelligence
subtitle: University of Verona · Verona, Italy
description: Thesis: Optimizing Industrial Operations via Foundation Models — Integrating Time-Series Predictive Maintenance and Zero-Shot Visual Quality Control. Research focuses on improving industrial operations through advanced deep learning: predictive maintenance using time-series data, zero-shot anomaly detection for automated quality inspection, and efficient Foundation Model solutions deployable on embedded devices.

title: Master's in Computer Engineering for Robotics and Smart Industries
subtitle: University of Verona · Verona, Italy · Grade: 108/110
description: Thesis: Deep Learning for Indoor Human Trajectory Prediction: A Generative Modeling Approach. Presented a novel approach to human trajectory prediction in indoor environments, focusing on shoppers' movement in supermarkets. Leveraged conditional variational autoencoders and integrated time-series data preprocessing to improve temporal continuity, resulting in a peer-reviewed publication.

description: Thesis: LiveVision AR — Real-Time Segmentation and Enhancement for Immersive Environments. Utilized C# and EMGUCV for real-time image segmentation and enhancement, integrating real-world objects into 3D augmented environments by isolating and enhancing them from live video feeds.
